Defined in: website/components/home/mosaic/burn/mount.ts:70

Mounts the combustion canvas over the title's current box: measures the h2 and overlay at hover-instant and plays the dissolve exactly where the glyphs stand. The DOM ink hides as soon as the canvas takes over, so the card's expand ease running behind it can't double-draw the title at its moving flex-end position.

Parameters

cardEl

Element

The expanded mosaic card.

overlay

HTMLElement

The title overlay element (canvas parent).

The h2 whose ink the canvas replaces.

The card's mosaic item (description length paces the burn).
